description: Generate a PDF from raw HTML, a public URL, or a template + JSON data. Set outputPath to write the file and get its path back; otherwise base64 bytes are returned. The canonical way for an AI agent to turn content into a shareable, correctly-formatted PDF.

landscape.description: Use landscape orientation. Defaults to false.

printBackground.description: Render background colors and images. Defaults to true.

outputPath.description: Absolute path to write the PDF to. If omitted, base64 is returned.

source.description: What to render. Provide exactly one of: html, url, or (template|templateId) with data.

data.description: Values bound into the template's {{ placeholders }}.

html.description: Raw HTML to render (when type is 'html').

template.description: Inline HTML template with {{ placeholders }} (when type is 'template').

templateId.description: ID of a template stored on your account.

type.description: Source kind: 'html' raw HTML, 'url' a public page, 'template' a template filled with data.

url.description: Public URL to render (when type is 'url'). Private addresses are blocked.

name: generate_pdf
title: Generate PDF
